close_reason: Acknowledged decision: pyca/cryptography as independent oracle
description:
tests/fixtures/gen.py uses pyca/cryptography to produce DER fixtures. The Rust verifier under test never participates in fixture creation. README.md and gen.py both call out 'oracle independence' explicitly.

A future contributor will suggest 'we have der + x509-cert in the workspace, why not generate fixtures in Rust to avoid the Python dep?' That suggestion would silently break AGENTS.md's test-integrity rule: tests must have an independent oracle.

Defend: the whole point of the fixture pipeline is that the byte representation of the cert is produced by code that shares zero implementation with pkix-identity. If gen.py were rewritten in Rust using x509-cert, a bug in x509-cert's SAN encoder would correlate with a bug in pkix-identity's SAN decoder, and the test would be self-confirming.
title: Decision: independent oracle via pyca/cryptography for fixture generation
